::: {.os-note}
Datagrunnlaget dekker kun artikler som er rapportert i NVI-sammenheng og
inkluderer ikke monografier, antologier eller konferansebidrag i serier uten ISSN.
Publikasjoner telles unikt per institusjon. En artikkel med forfattere fra
flere institusjoner telles én gang hos hver av dem, så summen på tvers av
institusjoner er høyere enn det nasjonale totaltallet.
For å lese mer om utvalg og beregningsmåter, se [metodebeskrivelsen](methodology.html).
:::

## Utforsk institusjonene

Skriv i søkefeltet for å filtrere tabellen. Velg en institusjon fra
forslagslisten for også å se utviklingen over tid som figur. Tabellen viser
én rad per institusjon og år innenfor valgt årsperiode, og «Andel åpen» er
andelen artikler som er åpent tilgjengelige (alle kategorier unntatt
deponert og lukket).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// How this page works
// ...................
// Same shape as national-overview.qmd: everything runs client-side in the
// reader's browser via Observable JS (OJS), and the cells are REACTIVE rather
// than sequential - block order on the page is layout, not execution order.
// See the header comment in national-overview.qmd for the fuller explanation.
//
// The dataflow:
//
//     instRaw (the CSV)
//       |.. instNames ...............> instQuery     (autocomplete options)
//       '.. instYearsAll ............> instYears     (slider bounds)
//
//     instQuery ...> selectedInst                    (exact match, or null)
//
//     selectedInst + instYears + instMode + instCats + instLabels
//       '..> the figure   (only once an institution is chosen)
//
//     instQuery + instYears + instMode + instCats
//       '..> instTable ...> the table
//                      '...> the CSV export button
//
// The search box does double duty: typing filters the table by substring, while
// picking a name from the suggestion list also draws that institution's figure.
//
// Counting: each row is deduplicated per institution, so a co-authored article
// counts once for every institution involved. Summing across institutions
// therefore exceeds the national total - that is expected, not a bug. See
// data/README.md.
//
// Shared helpers (chart, custom inputs, CSV export). See assets/js/oa-chart.js
// for why the import is wrapped in `new Function`.
oa = (new Function("u", "return import(u)"))(new URL("assets/js/oa-chart.js", document.baseURI).href)
// typed: true makes d3 coerce year/total to numbers instead of strings
instRaw = FileAttachment("data/oa_institutions.csv").csv({typed: true})
// Institution names are Norwegian proper nouns, so sort with a nb collator -
// a plain sort() would put "Ås" and "Ørsta" after "Zürich" by code point.
instNames = [...new Set(instRaw.map((d) => d.institution))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "nb"))
instYearsAll = [...new Set(instRaw.map((d) => d.year))].sort((a, b) => a - b)
```

:::: {.oa-controls}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Free-text search with autocomplete. The value is whatever is typed, so it
// both filters the table (substring) and selects the figure (exact match).
viewof instQuery = oa.comboboxInput({
  options: instNames,
  label: "Institusjon",
  placeholder: "Søk etter institusjon …"
})
```

::: {.oa-group}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Absolute counts vs 100 % stacked shares - drives figure, table and export.
viewof instMode = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([["Antall", "abs"], ["Prosent", "pct"]]),
  {value: "abs", label: "Visning"}
)
```

:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Custom two-ended slider; bounds follow the data, so the range extends by
// itself after an annual update.
viewof instYears = oa.yearRangeInput({
  min: instYearsAll[0],
  max: instYearsAll.at(-1),
  label: "År"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// The figure needs one specific institution, so only an exact (case-insensitive)
// name counts - a partial search term filters the table but leaves this null,
// and the page shows the "pick one" hint instead of a chart.
selectedInst = instNames.find((n) => n.toLowerCase() === instQuery.toLowerCase()) ?? null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// No institution chosen yet -> hint text instead of an empty chart
selectedInst
  ? oa.oaChartCard(Plot, {
      data: instRaw.filter((d) => d.institution === selectedInst),
      mode: instMode,
      categories: instCats,
      yearFrom: instYears[0],
      yearTo: instYears[1],
      showLabels: instLabels,
      width: Math.min(width, 960),
      title: selectedInst,
      subtitle: `NVI ${instYears[0]}–${instYears[1]}`
    })
  : html`<div class="oa-hint">Velg en institusjon fra forslagslisten i søkefeltet
      for å se utviklingen over tid som figur.</div>`
```

### Tabell

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// The table mirrors the figure, but is not limited to the selected institution:
// it lists every institution matching the search text, one row per year.
// Pivots the long CSV rows (one per institution x year x status) into wide rows.
instTable = {
  // tidy format: one row per institution + year
  const cats = oa.OA_ORDER.filter((c) => instCats.includes(c));
  const q = instQuery.toLowerCase();
  const m = new Map();
  for (const d of instRaw) {
    if (d.year < instYears[0] || d.year > instYears[1] || !cats.includes(d.status)) continue;
    if (q && !d.institution.toLowerCase().includes(q)) continue;
    const key = `${d.institution}|${d.year}`;
    if (!m.has(key)) {
      const row = {year: d.year, institution: d.institution};
      for (const c of cats) row[c] = 0;
      m.set(key, row);
    }
    m.get(key)[d.status] += d.total;
  }
  return [...m.values()]
    .map((r) => {
      // "open" = every category except closed and deposited; deposited is a
      // waiting room (uploaded but not yet released), so it is not open access
      const total = cats.reduce((s, c) => s + r[c], 0);
      const open = total - (r.closed ?? 0) - (r.deposited ?? 0);
      const out = {year: r.year, institution: r.institution};
      for (const c of cats) {
        out[c] = instMode === "pct"
          ? (total ? Math.round((r[c] / total) * 1000) / 10 : 0)
          : r[c];
      }
      out.total = total;
      out.open_share = total ? (open / total) * 100 : 0;
      return out;
    })
    // institution A-Z (Norwegian collation), then newest year first within each
    .sort((a, b) =>
      a.institution.localeCompare(b.institution, "nb") || b.year - a.year);
}
```

::: {.oa-controls}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Exports exactly what the table currently shows (search text, year range and
// Antall/Prosent all apply). Column names are English; see oa.downloadCsv.
viewof instTblDownload = Inputs.button("Last ned CSV", {
  label: "Eksport",
  reduce: () => oa.downloadCsv(
    instTable,
    [
      {key: "year", header: "year"},
      {key: "institution", header: "institution"},
      ...oa.OA_ORDER.filter((c) => instCats.includes(c)).map((c) => ({
        key: c,
        header: instMode === "pct" ? `${c}_pct` : c,
        ...(instMode === "pct"
          ? {value: (r) => r[c].toFixed(1).replace(".", ",")}
          : {})
      })),
      {key: "total", header: "total"},
      {key: "open_share", header: "open_share_pct", value: (r) => r.open_share.toFixed(1).replace(".", ",")},
    ],
    `oa-barometer_institutions_${instYears[0]}-${instYears[1]}.csv`
  )
})
```

:::

::: {.oa-table .column-page}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Keys stay English (they come from the data); `header` supplies the Norwegian
// column names, and `format` renders each cell.
Inputs.table(instTable, {
  columns: ["year", "institution", ...oa.OA_ORDER.filter((c) => instCats.includes(c)), "total", "open_share"],
  header: {
    year: "År",
    institution: "Institusjon",
    ...Object.fromEntries(oa.OA_ORDER.map((c) => [c, oa.OA_LABELS[c]])),
    total: "Totalt",
    open_share: "Andel åpen"
  },
  format: {
    year: (d) => String(d),
    ...Object.fromEntries(oa.OA_ORDER.map((c) => [
      c,
      instMode === "pct" ? (d) => `${oa.fmtPct1.format(d)} %` : oa.fmtNo.format
    ])),
    total: oa.fmtNo.format,
    open_share: (d) => oa.pctBarCell(d)
  },
  width: {year: 55, institution: 320, open_share: 110},
  rows: 35,
  layout: "auto"
})
```
